We use your first name in notifications and in the weekly summary. Your last name only shows up if you ever share your results or join a training group; your profile starts out private.
Your age sets your heart-rate zones, your estimated sweat rate and how many calories you need in high-load weeks. It also lets us compare you against performance tables for your category.
Which biological sex should we use for sweat rate?

Sweat rates, sodium loss and calorie burn differ quite a bit between men and women at the same weight and pace. We only use it for the plan: it is not shown on your profile and not shared. If you\'d rather not answer, we use an average.
Lower average sweat rate and different sodium loss
Higher average sweat rate at the same weight and pace
We use an average of both to estimate your plan

Weight is the base of the calculation: litres of fluid per hour, milligrams of sodium and grams of carbohydrate to replace are all estimated per kilo. Height adjusts your resting energy expenditure. You can update both any time from your profile.

Each discipline burns fluid and carbohydrate differently: on the bike you can drink more and eat solids, running you are better off splitting it up. Pick the one you train most; you can add the others later from your profile.
How long have you been training?

It sets the volume your plan starts at and how much it can grow each week without putting you at risk of injury. If you are coming back after a long break, pick beginner: the load can always go up later.
Under a year of training, or coming back after a break
Over 3 years, with races on the calendar

With the event date we build the countdown and lay out the build, recovery and taper weeks. If you haven\'t picked a race yet, continue without a date: we build a base plan and adjust it once you set one.
No date yet: we\'ll build a base plan.

We are not doctors and this app does not replace a consultation. If you have any pre-existing condition, take medication, or haven\'t trained in years, talk to a professional before starting the plan.

How do you measure your sessions?
If you connect your watch or the phone\'s GPS, we tune hydration and gels to your real pace and heart rate instead of estimates. You can skip this and connect it later from Settings.
Pace and distance, no extra gear

This is not a profile detail: it is what triggers the alerts. We write to you before each session so you can get bottles, gels and the pre-session snack ready, and we use your times to place the long sessions on the days you have more room.
